en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Washha, from Aban, from Lays Al Murady, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Abu Saeed Al-Khudry, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> had Graced him this view, and his snatching (of his soul) was difficult upon him. So he said, ‘Carry me to my prayer-mat’. So they carried him, and it was not long that he died’.
en.sarwar: 4. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla’ ibn Muhammad from al-Washsha’ from Aban from Layth al-Muradiy who has said the following:

“Abu ‘Abdullah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that abu Sa’eed al-Khudriy, a person of God-given good point, faced difficulties when dying. He asked his people to place him where he would perform his prayers and when they did as they were told, he died shortly thereafter.”
